methodology: Codex independently reopened current official, regulatory and operating sources; checked the existing repository citations; searched for the Argo acquisition, later exits and the announced Apollo-Argo manager transaction; and reconciled the umbrella record against the separately published Bayonne and Middletown concession records.
identityConclusion: US Water Systems is not supported as a legal entity or manager-level operating platform. It is a repository umbrella that duplicates two separate concession SPVs already represented as Bayonne Water and Wastewater Concession and Middletown Water Joint Venture LLC. No truthful single-company redirect exists because the relationship is one-to-many.
ownershipConclusion: Argo remains the infrastructure manager associated with both concession investments, with Veolia operating the systems. The Apollo-Argo manager acquisition did not close and was terminated in January 2026; Apollo must not be added as an owner.
exitSearchConclusion: No later sale or signed pending exit of the Bayonne or Middletown concessions was found through 2026-08-16. Current operating and government records show both concessions remain active.
recommendedRecordDisposition: Archive the US Water Systems umbrella without a redirect while retaining Bayonne and Middletown as separate canonical companies. This supported mutation was not proposed or applied because both permitted GPT-5.6 Pro responses were structurally malformed.
